held_fixed: net shape and edit count, so a fall in Efficacy is the TASK getting harder and not a smaller model or a bigger edit
why_competence_is_the_cross_rung_damage_: Damage across rungs is reported as a drop in COMPETENCE - the fraction of positions whose argmax is IN the optimal set. That means the same thing at 3,3,3 and at 4,4,4, which a divergence between move distributions does not: a total variation is bounded and compresses as the distribution spreads over a bigger board, while a KL does not, so either would turn board size into a trend. The set-valued accuracy has no such dependence.
verdict: Efficacy first falls below 1.0 at rung 3,4,3, under ALL THREE criteria
